name: shared control: PII stored at rest without encryption
note: The SAME control, the SAME triples, run against BOTH institutions. warn = an unencrypted-at-rest volume still admits (full LEF); deny = admission blocks it (LEF collapses toward zero). Triples are (min, mode, max); LEF = loss events/year, LM = £/event. Nothing here is institution-specific — the ONLY thing that differs across driftwood and ludlow is the risk-appetite tolerance band in ../../../platform/risk/appetite.json. That band alone flips the £-derived verdict Audit->Deny. That is proportionality: identical control, opposite enforcement, because the £ each institution can carry differs.
